scope: Sasada, Staffilani and Sun: the fourth mathematical-physics batch.

independent_build.method: Archive the exact source commit and pinned theme commit into a clean directory; run all workflow source checks, build, then run four generated-site checks.

live_verification.tls: Default certificate verification; no insecure overrides
live_verification.comparison: Entire responses compared with the independent build. Only indentation between tags and whitespace at display-math boundaries is normalized; prose and formulas are preserved.

browser.scope: All new pages plus the subject index at desktop and mobile widths; formulas, overflow, subject navigation, search and legacy query/fragment redirects.

historical_records: The fourth-validation record preserves local acceptance. This separate record verifies the later public deployment.
proof_scope: Elementary derivations and prerequisite lemmas are proved in atomic notes; the packets enumerate precisely cited research inputs, conditional claims and unexpanded deep proofs.
